source_name: IUS-INFO – dnevne novice (legal/business news wire)
why_relevant: Legal-information service whose news wire reported the national instant-payments scheme timeline early. Useful as a corroborating, date-stamped record for infrastructure programmes that later generate bank-level contracts.

source_name: PISRS – ZJN-3A amendment
why_relevant: Amendment act; amendments are where publication duties and value thresholds shift, which changes which banking/payments contracts become visible.

source_name: PISRS – ZJN-3C amendment
why_relevant: Later amendment of the Public Procurement Act; needed to date-align notice obligations when reading historical award notices.

source_name: PISRS – ZJN-3D amendment (consolidated view / pregledNpb)
why_relevant: Most recent amendment found; the NPB (neuradno prečiščeno besedilo) view is the practical way to read the law as currently in force.

source_name: PISRS – Zakon o dostopu do informacij javnega značaja (ZDIJZ)
why_relevant: The FOI statute. Articles 6.a/6.č/10.a define absolute public data on contracts of entities under dominant public-law influence and mandatory online publication — the legal hook for obtaining banking/payments contracts and annexes that never appear on the procurement portal.

source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec (IPRS) – Iskalnik po odločbah (FOI decisions search)
why_relevant: Searchable database of Information Commissioner appeal decisions. Decisions routinely name the applicant, the liable body and the concrete contract in dispute — including bank/financial-institution cases — and often reproduce contract details. The single richest route to contracts that were withheld and then ordered disclosed.

source_name: IPRS – ZDIJZ legislation & guidance hub
why_relevant: Regulator's own consolidated guidance on FOI scope, exemptions and the business-secret vs public-funds override — tells a collector in advance which banking contract fields are obtainable.

source_name: IPRS – Vodnik po praksi ZDIJZ (15 let ZDIJZ guide, PDF)
why_relevant: Case-law digest of 15 years of FOI practice; the fastest way to learn which contract categories (including with commercial banks and payment providers) have been ruled disclosable, and on what reasoning.

source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) – national notice portal and archive
why_relevant: The statutory publication venue under ZJN-3 for contract notices, award decisions and award notices, operated by Uradni list RS. Its /arhiv/{id}/ paths hold superseded and historical notices — this is the archive the cell brief asks about.

source_name: Direktorat za javno naročanje (MJU) – annual statistical reports on awarded contracts
why_relevant: Statutory annual statistics on awarded contracts including the below-threshold 'evidenčna naročila' regime and the >10,000 EUR disclosure duty — this is exactly the source that tells later rounds which value bands are visible and which hide contracts.

source_name: OPSI – Odprti podatki Slovenije: aktualna javna naročila (e-JN dataset)
why_relevant: Machine-readable feed of current public procurements from e-JN (contracting authority, title, code, publication time, deadline, status) — the cheapest structured entry point before falling back to HTML scraping.

source_name: Erar (erar.si) – public money flows application, KPK / built with Danes je nov dan lineage
why_relevant: Transaction-level view of payments by public bodies and state-owned companies to named suppliers. Reveals actual money paid to banks/payment vendors even where no award notice exists (below-threshold, framework call-offs). Relaunched 5 March 2025 with e-invoices and expanded obliged-party data.

source_name: Komisija za preprečevanje korupcije (KPK) – research, analyses and statistics
why_relevant: Anti-corruption commission analyses of procurement risk and integrity; also operates the Erar obliged-party lists and publishes data-quality caveats (e.g. its statement on incorrect UJP data before the new Erar launch) that matter for interpreting spending data.

source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) – procurement review decisions
why_relevant: Independent review body for procurement legality. Decisions expose bidder identities, evaluation criteria and technical specifications for contested tenders, including financial-services and payment-related lots that the award notice alone would not reveal.

source_name: Računsko sodišče RS – audit archive (revizijska poročila)
why_relevant: Court of Audit reports routinely reproduce contract values, counterparties and procedure defects for IT and financial-services procurements, including cases where notices were never published — a way to see contracts that escaped the portal.

source_name: Transparency International Slovenia (Društvo Integriteta) – research and indices
why_relevant: The NGO named in the cell brief. Its National Integrity System study and CPI commentary treat public procurement as a systemic weak point; it is also an active FOI applicant (it appears as 'prosilec' in IPRS decisions), so its cases surface concrete withheld contracts.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: Central bank's own FOI catalogue: names the categories of information it holds and its FOI contact/route. Directly relevant because Banka Slovenije is both a procurement authority for payment infrastructure and a frequent FOI respondent (it appears as an obliged party in IPRS decisions).

source_name: AJPES – ZDIJZ-driven data provision and public register basics
why_relevant: AJPES supplies daily base datasets to OPSI under ZDIJZ and holds the business register plus annual accounts; needed to resolve award-notice supplier names to legal entities and ownership (including which suppliers are under dominant public-law influence, triggering contract-disclosure duties).

source_name: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) – EU notices incl. Slovenian above-threshold contract awards
why_relevant: Above-threshold Slovenian notices are duplicated to TED with English summaries and, since October 2023, structured eForms. TED is the archive of record when the national portal is hard to crawl, and the only route giving English-language field-level data on Slovenian banking/payments awards.

source_name: Uradni list Republike Slovenije – official gazette (publisher of enarocanje.si, source of ZJN-3/ZDIJZ texts)
why_relevant: The gazette of record: original publication of ZJN-3 and every amendment (with exact effective dates), and the operator of the public procurement portal. The authoritative fallback when PISRS consolidated text is ambiguous about when a threshold changed.

source_name: Sodna praksa (sodnapraksa.si) – Administrative/Supreme Court rulings on FOI and procurement
why_relevant: Judicial review of IPRS FOI decisions and of procurement disputes. Where a bank or public body appeals a disclosure order, the judgment (e.g. VSRS I Up 10/2018 line of cases) settles what is permanently obtainable.

source_name: DKOM – Iskalnik po odločitvah (full-text decision search engine)
why_relevant: Keyword search across DKOM decisions – the practical entry point for topic-scoped retrieval such as 'bančne storitve', 'plačilni promet', 'POS terminali', 'kartično poslovanje'. Lets an analyst isolate the banking/payments subset out of ~thousands of decisions instead of crawling everything.

source_name: DKOM – Poročila o delu (annual work reports / review statistics)
why_relevant: Annual reports to the National Assembly containing statistics on review requests by procurement subject matter, outcomes (granted/partly granted/rejected), average resolution time and contracting-authority breakdowns. Gives the denominator for judging how contested a sector is, and flags trends in disputed sectors.
